subject: Corvus Logistics is behind the median on governance
body:
Daniel,

Your governance score of 33 sits in the bottom quartile compared to similar logistics operators, and well below average for the sector. Tooling at 57 is closer to the benchmark, so the gap is oversight.

Most organisations that run three pilots without one sticking have the same underlying problem, and around 70 percent never reach production.

Nebius Academy programmes are taught by practitioners who run AI in production. Worth 20 minutes?

Adam
facts_used: Programs are taught by practitioners who run AI in production
